steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') })()

steps.name: cmdk-glabel-i
steps.eval: (() => { const ls=[...document.querySelectorAll('.cmdk-glabel')].map(e=>e.style.getPropertyValue('--i')); const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.cmdk-item')].slice(0,4).map(e=>e.style.getPropertyValue('--i')); console.log('PROBE cmdk --i labels', JSON.stringify(ls), 'items', JSON.stringify(it)) })()

steps.name: probe-card-rect
steps.eval: (() => { const c=document.querySelectorAll('.cat-card.liftable')[1]||document.querySelector('.cat-card.liftable'); const r=c.getBoundingClientRect(); console.log('PROBE cat-card center', Math.round(r.left+r.width/2), Math.round(r.top+r.height/2)) })()

steps.name: seed-items
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const defs=['sofa-3seat','coffee-table','armchair','tv-console','bed-queen','dining-table','wardrobe','bookshelf','desk','nightstand']; const items=[]; let i=0; for (const r of s.floorPlan.rooms) { if (typeof r.width!=='number'||typeof r.depth!=='number') continue; const cx=r.origin[0]+r.width/2, cz=r.origin[1]+r.depth/2; for (let k=0;k<3;k++){ items.push({ id:`seed-${i}`, defId: defs[i%defs.length], position:[cx+(k-1)*0.05, cz+(k-1)*0.05], rotation:0, props:{} }); i++; } } s.setItems(items); console.log('PROBE seeded items', i) })()

steps.name: probe-layers-rects
steps.eval: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('.lyr-body'); const rb=b.getBoundingClientRect(); const row=document.querySelector('.lyr-row'); const rr=row.getBoundingClientRect(); console.log('PROBE lyr-body center', Math.round(rb.left+rb.width/2), Math.round(rb.top+rb.height/2), 'scrollH', b.scrollHeight, 'clientH', b.clientHeight); console.log('PROBE lyr-row center', Math.round(rr.left+rr.width/2), Math.round(rr.top+rr.height/2)) })()

steps.name: focus-row-action
steps.eval: (() => { const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.lyr-row')]; const target=rows[2]||rows[0]; const btn=target.querySelector('.lyr-acts button'); btn.focus() })()

steps.name: probe-empty-lh
steps.eval: (() => { const sp=document.querySelector('.empty-mini span'); console.log('PROBE empty-mini span line-height', sp && getComputedStyle(sp).lineHeight, 'font-size', sp && getComputedStyle(sp).fontSize) })()
